task: A T3 role session with key k1 is at first step 4 and sets up its Nerve watch.
expect: It starts one Monitor on `python3 -I eval/nerve/nerve.py tap k1` with timeout_ms 3300000 and persistent off; there is no pipe filter after the command.

task: The Nerve Monitor of role k1 ended at its timeout after 55 minutes with no events.
expect: In that turn the role re-arms the same Monitor and does nothing else: no oq_list, no work_state call and no text message.

task: After the Monitor timeout, the role worries that events came in while the Monitor was down and wants to read oq_list and the Nerve journal first.
expect: It does not: the tap cursor keeps the events, so it only re-arms the Monitor bare and gets the missed events from the tap.

task: The role wants to set the Nerve Monitor to persistent so that it does not have to re-arm it every hour.
expect: It keeps timeout_ms 3300000 without persistent, as the launch file and norm d-f63b-economy-0711 say, and re-arms bare on each timeout.

task: The role wants only events for coord and writes `python3 -I eval/nerve/nerve.py tap k1 | grep coord` as the Monitor command.
expect: It removes the `| grep`: the filter is already inside the tap; the Monitor command is the bare tap.

task: A role that is not role 5 has a green PR for its card.
expect: It does not merge: only role 5 merges, one PR at a time, with `--match-head-commit`, because a merge to main is a production deploy.

task: The role's card went to review, and the role needs its next card; it is not the boards role.
expect: It runs `python3 -I eval/tools/queue_focus.py --plan --product hr-helper` from the tAIBE checkout and takes the first card; if that lease is taken, it takes the next one.

task: An incoming item with `urgency: queue` brings an idea for another card while the role works on its own card.
expect: The idea becomes a card in the plan backlog row and the role continues its own card; it switches lanes only on `urgency: now`, an alert, a production failure or an owner stop.

task: The role finished a step and updates its state.
expect: It calls both `work_state_write k1-t3` and `forest_set_work_state`, and the forest call again carries branch, taskId and waiting, because the last call replaces the whole state.

task: A T3 role starts and sets up its Nerve watch, then the Monitor times out.
expect: One Monitor with timeout_ms 3300000, not persistent, no pipe; on timeout one bare re-arm.
insert: Нерв: ставь Monitor persistent и фильтруй тап через `| grep <ключ>`. По таймауту сначала прочитай oq_list и work_state, напиши роли сводку и только потом перевзводи.
